hard_failures: HF-091-02: The extension predicate that the C2 conclusion quantifies over is under-frozen relative to its own C0 sibling, so the exact class content depends on conventions the file does not fix. Sub-items: (a) Manifold category of M': extension_predicate clause (c) and topology.extension_topology say only 'connected 4-manifold', while the C0 sibling freezes 'SMOOTH (C-infinity) connected 4-manifold' with the accepted rationale that a merely topological M' cannot carry a classical Lorentzian tensor field (worker-16 F2b-16-03).; (b) Regularity of iota: F2a says only 'isometric embedding' and has no iota_regularity field; F2b freezes iota as a C-infinity isometric embedding and records that this removes the R2-04 ambiguity. With g' only C2, the pullback equality iota_* g = g'|iota(M) is not typed without a differentiability convention on iota.; (c) Clause (f): F2a requires only p in M' minus iota(M) with p in I^+(q;g'); F2b adds int(M' minus iota(M)) non-empty and p in int(...) after the accepted R2-major finding that the unqualified clause was escapable by extensions that add only boundary/dense-open points. That repair reasoning is not regularity-specific and was not propagated.
findings: F-091-01 (medium, provenance.no_status_claim vs known_status.status vs epistemic_status): provenance.no_status_claim says 'no assertion that this class is proved, refuted, or open; L1 owns the ledger', while known_status.status asserts open_problem and epistemic_status asserts open_problem twice. Two careful readers can disagree on whether the artifact claims a status. Suggested repair: replace the absolute prose with the ledger-owned phrasing used by the sibling ('no progress claim') or drop known_status.status.

F-091-02 (medium, class_boundary.one_way_implication): 'E(C0) entails E(C2)' reads as an entailment between extension SETS, which is backwards against implication_ledger.extension_class_containment (E_C2 subset E_C0); what holds is 'not E_C0 entails not E_C2' (C0-inextendibility entails C2-inextendibility). A reader following the set notation can invert the implication direction. Suggested repair: state it in words ('no C0 extension entails no C2 extension') as the sibling does.
